correctness.rationale: The cycle-rooted-forest determinant gives P(K=k) proportional to (n)_k/n^k, and leaf removal gives conditional mean (n-k)(1-1/n)^(n-k-1). The difference is -k/n times a positive power, giving strict negative covariance n>=4. Half-normal convergence of K/sqrt(n), a telescoped quadratic expansion of its conditional leaf mean and moment domination prove Cov/sqrt(n) -> -sqrt(2/pi)/(2e). Independently checked exact mean identity for n=8. The earlier stronger full derivation independently confirms it.
